# RBX Labs

RBX Labs is a founder-led applied AI studio. It builds trustworthy AI products, AI workflows, and AI-enabled go-to-market systems, and delivers AI training and event sessions.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://rbx-labs.io/
- About: https://rbx-labs.io/about.html
- Approach: https://rbx-labs.io/approach.html
- AI Training: https://rbx-labs.io/ai-training.html
- Case study / product example: https://rbx-labs.io/network-guardian.html
- Google Cloud Generative AI Leader study guide: https://rbx-labs.io/GAIL/

## What RBX Labs does
- Builds AI-powered products and internal tools
- Designs AI workflows that reduce manual work and improve throughput
- Creates AI-enabled go-to-market systems for research, content, outreach, qualification, and sales support
- Runs AI training through workshops, sprints, and adoption programs
- Designs trustworthy AI workflows with evaluation, human oversight, monitoring, and escalation paths
- Delivers AI training, talks, and event sessions for enterprise, founder, student, and developer audiences

## Direct answers
- **What is RBX Labs?** An applied AI studio focused on product, workflow, and go-to-market execution.
- **Who does RBX Labs work with?** Founders, product teams, and operators who need AI systems that ship and get adopted.
- **What outcomes does RBX Labs target?** Shipped systems, measurable efficiency gains, improved activation, and clearer launch execution.
- **Does RBX Labs deliver AI training and events?** Yes. RBX Labs runs workflow-specific workshops, sprints, adoption programs, and event sessions; its founder has trained 5.8K+ learners and is a Stanford Code in Place section leader.
- **How does RBX Labs approach AI trust?** By building evaluation, human oversight, monitoring, and escalation controls into the operating workflow.
- **What experience informs the work?** Founder Rishabh Banga has a Carnegie Mellon M.S. in Software Management and Responsible AI experience at Microsoft; RBX Labs also represents experience across Microsoft, NASA, Ericsson, Intel, and product ventures.

## Proof points
- 25% activation lift from ranking improvements in a community product
- 40% reduction in manual review from trust-led moderation systems
- 30% throughput gain from AI workflow transformation
- 98%+ valid itineraries with a 12-second P95 pipeline in a TravelTech venture
- 5.8K+ learners trained across AI, product, and innovation programs
- 606 hours of training delivery for 692 attendees, recognized with Ericsson's L&D Rockstar award
- Stanford Code in Place section leadership and AI-trust sessions for technical and founder communities
